desktop.notesZh: demo22 四问题批次：会话弹窗七点改版（分段列表/变更号固定右上角/产物可点链接/横排主次按钮/修改意见回路/会话面板内模态）+ 输出骨架去粗体（** 【】** 反复复发根修：直接去 **，括号即标题）+ 语言跟随（persona 中英双份语言跟随段）+ 确认等待停表（intake 窗口不计 duration，running 标志冻结走表）。详见 enterprise-workflow.md §22.23。
desktop.notesEn: Demo22 four-issue round: session dialog redesign (segmented lists, change chip top-right, clickable artifacts, horizontal primary/secondary buttons, revision loop, in-pane modal) + persona skeleton de-bolded (final fix: drop ** entirely, brackets are the heading) + language-follow paragraphs (CN+EN) + waiting-not-counted metric (intake window excluded, running flag freezes interpolation). See enterprise-workflow.md §22.23 for the panorama.
